name: mio-compare-packet-design
notes: DESIGN ONLY. Read verified completed packet artifacts, never raw future data. proposed uses must be implemented. Comparison is descriptive; selection criteria remain a separate owner input.

results.notes: PROPOSED verifier. Verify exact receipt, artifact content, source and computation identities plus shared exposure records. A result from another pair set, source snapshot, packet or cohort cannot substitute. Failed variants prevent a complete comparison.

comparison.notes: PROPOSED child report node. Produce per-method, per-packet and pair/week coverage with the declared metrics, paired method deltas within each packet and replay/timeout status. Keep different cohorts and reset account curves separate. Produce report as JsonArtifact. Report no winner while primary_metric/selection thresholds are unset.
